entries.zh: 束；把（捆扎成一把之物）〔汉字栏作「箱」（箱匣），与西义不合〕
entries.en: a bunch or bundle of anything; Hanzi column reads 箱 (box, chest; mismatch)
entries.notes: 西语 manojo（一把、一束）与汉字「箱」（箱匣）不对应，字识或词目归并存疑；R 栏空。
汉字「悦/慨」存疑；L 栏附加语 q. cusiros 未能展开（疑为参见项）；R 栏空。

entries.zh: 软顺；柔顺温驯，受责骂不还口
entries.en: tame, gentle; soft and compliant, giving no answer even when scolded

entries.zh: 手快（手脚麻利）；顺从不顶嘴
entries.en: quick-handed, nimble; docile, not answering when scolded
entries.notes: 汉字「手快」（敏捷）与西语「受骂不答」不完全吻合，或指温顺而手脚勤快。

entries.zh: 手软（下手软、不动手还击）；温顺

entries.en: livestock, domestic animal; tame as beasts (cf. headword note 'çiau zo')
entries.notes: 汉字「畜/富」存疑；M 栏多重读音杂录难以确解；L、M 两栏另见 çiau zo 音写，义未定。

entries.en: livestock, sacrificial animal; tame as animals
to come out of the den or nest (of animals); tame as animals
entries.notes: 汉字「岫/峀」存疑；岫取闽语禽畜巢穴义，与「驯如禽兽」关联不甚直接。

entries.en: livestock, domestic animals; those of house and possession are called 'manços' (tame)
cloth (manta), of the kind sold (in trade)
quilt, bed-coverlet (to cover oneself in bed)
entries.notes: L 栏 p̃（para）缩写展开为推断，词头 mança 疑为 manta 之误；被＝卧盖之被与西义吻合。

entries.zh: 孝布（服丧所用的细白布）
entries.en: mourning cloth (fine white cloth worn in filial mourning)
entries.notes: 西语 celana / meria 未解（celana 或为 de lana 之误连写）；孝布义据汉字栏明确。

entries.zh: 〔原件污损难辨，释义存疑〕疑为蓝布；汉字「蚤血布」之「蚤」或为「蠶」，音写不全
entries.en: blue manta cloth (uncertain); Hanzi doubtful (蚤/蠶), partly illegible
entries.notes: T99 污损难辨且 [疑:蚤/蠶]；M 栏音写与 azul（蓝）难以对应，释义存疑。

entries.zh: 斜纹布（斜纹织造的布，即 cordonzillo 斜纹呢）
entries.notes: [疑:文/紋] 仅涉异体字（斜文＝斜紋，义同），四栏互证语义明确。
